g.text: PR #2394 · Explain Claude permissions, thinking and scheduler activity
Typed Claude metadata was stored but invisible in the transcript.
Readers now see approval provenance, thinking time and what woke the agent.
BEFORE
AFTER
User / Assistant renderers
Approval actor and thinking time are absent.
Empty tool output also hides approval context.
render_tool_result_permission
Join tool_result_meta to the matching tool id.
Show approval chips and per-frame thinking time.
CommandLifecycle
Every lifecycle frame is omitted.
A scheduler fire looks like an unexplained turn.
command_wakeup_label
Only started scheduler commands make dividers.
Duplicate command ids do not repeat the marker.
Result / Init renderers
Safety-stop totals and extra folders are hidden.
Missing fields cannot explain session context.
safety_stops / render_init_directories
Label safety stops as a process running total.
Folders distinguish unknown from an empty list.
Scope: existing compaction grouping is unchanged; repeated compacting statuses need a live fixture before deduplication.
